title: Causal note container
description: The single JSON container stored in each refs/notes/vcs-lab note blob. Only this container yields records; an unparsable note is preserved as one opaque legacy record ({type: 'legacy-note', text}) and any other JSON shape yields no records.

records.description: Causal records attached to this Git object, in append order. Each is one of the note-record families of this catalog, or a preserved legacy record.
